overall: POOR on the east side, GOOD on the Coron side: Coron, Galoc, Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Decabobo fish well; Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan stay shut all day
limiterDetail: The main limiter is a combination , led by east wind (Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan at 17–24 kt, gusts up to 31; Linapacan 13–16 kt), plus current at Decabaitot (1.4–1.7 kt), Barangonan and Alava (1.2–1.6 kt) late morning and again about 9 PM–1 AM, and Tara and Turda (1.0–1.1 kt early morning and late afternoon). Rain is minor: 0.2–0.4 mm/h at Barangonan, elsewhere dry.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The feed still lists an older tropical cyclone alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) that doesn't name Palawan; worth a glance on the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: The east wind no longer eases at Friday midday; it is stronger and lasts all of the next 24 hours, so Sat 7 supply drops from NEAR NORMAL to SLIGHTLY SOFT. Nangalao is at 23.6 kt now (gusts 31), Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 22.1 kt (gusts 29), Ciron 21.7 kt (gusts 29), and all four stay at 17–24 kt through Saturday 5 AM. Yesterday's forecast had them easing around noon to 1 PM today.

Fishing worsened to 5 GOOD / 3 MARGINAL / 4 POOR / 4 VERY POOR (was 5 GOOD / 4 MARGINAL / 7 POOR): those four east grounds are now VERY POOR. That makes five soft arrival days in a row (Wed 4 to Sun 8), so tightening risk is now high. PAGASA still shows no warning for Palawan.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). The dashboard's shortage detector stays ELEVATED for Fri–Thu (guide only; it reacts to the 0.6–0.7 kt daily currents). Tightening risk is now high (was moderate to high): five soft arrival days in a row (Wed 4 to Sun 8), and the east grounds will have missed about three days by Saturday morning. Lean on the Coron side, Galoc, Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Decabobo for weekend supply.

bestWindow.headline: About 11 AM–6 PM today at Panlaitan and Maglalambay; about 5 PM–1 AM on the Coron side; all day at Decabobo
details: Panlaitan and Maglalambay: 1–3 kt about 11 AM–6 PM, current 0.1–0.3. Coron and Galoc: 3–4 kt from about 5 PM to 1 AM, current 0.0–0.4. Decabobo: 2–8 kt, current 0.2–0.5 all day. Tara and Turda: wind is light, so go about 11 AM–1 PM or 10 PM–1 AM when the current eases to 0.4–0.6 kt. Alava and Binudac: easiest about 8–11 PM (6–8 kt), but current is 1.0–1.5 kt then, so 3–5 PM is the better compromise (10–11 kt, 0.6–0.8 kt current). East side: no usable window; the lightest spell is Ciron at 17–18 kt about 1–11 PM.
Keep small boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan all day and tonight (up to 24 kt, gusts near 31).
